audited_by: ep06-voice-worker (two fresh readers, third reader compared old/new)

faults.what: The clasp does not resolve into two hands: pale fingers come from both the dark coat sleeve and the tattooed arm around a fingerless brown lump, so it reads as three hands or one hand gripping a stone, and Indio's tattooed forearm is pale pink, not brown, with blue vine scrolls instead of his geometric tattoos.
faults.where: centre of frame, the clasp and the right forearm

faults.what: The doctor's hand and Rizal's hand melt into one knuckly fist with thumbs sprouting from it at several places; no fingers lie on a wrist, so it does not read as taking a pulse.
faults.where: centre, where the two sleeves meet

faults.what: A large flat teal blob with a hard ragged edge (a keying leftover, not breath) sits in the sky beside his head and runs into his cheek.
faults.where: left of his head, upper-left third

faults.what: The broken cord ends in a black hole in his skin, like a tube or wire plugged into his chest.
faults.where: upper right of the chest, above the hand

faults.what: M is porcelain-white with grey eyes and a round moe schoolgirl face with bangs, while in shot 2 she is a brown-skinned adult Filipina with brown eyes and no bangs.
Indio has short spiky hair with no topknot and a rounder, boyish face, unlike the topknotted Indio of shots 8, 10 and 12 right after.
Rizal (35) has plainly grey-silver hair under the bowler hat and reads as an old man; his hair should be black.
faults.where: back of the head under the hat

faults.what: Both of Usman's ears hang folded; he should have one folded ear and one upright.
Both ears stand up pointed with no folded ear, and the coat is shaggier than in his other shots.

The 1896 Indio switches between a collarless camisa (shots 20, 23, 27, 56) and a modern collared button shirt (shots 15, 34, 38, 43, 52, 58, 60); in shot 15 the medallion hangs on a gold chain, not a cord, and his forearms show no tattoos.
The medallion carries a sun-star design here (shot 13 shows a sun with a triangle, the other shots a plain disc), and his face and hair are drawn heavier and more realistic than in his other shots.

The pointing hand thrust at the camera is a knotted claw: the index finger up, a second finger behind it, a loose fingertip bulging out of the middle of the palm and a thumb with its nail facing us, with no readable ring finger or pinky.
faults.where: his right hand, lower left, the call-to-action shot

faults.what: The open palm shows only three fingers and a thumb; two of the fingertips sit stacked at the left so they are hard to read.
Flat black hair strands stick out sideways from behind the headband and the topknot like cut-out shapes, with a stray black speck beside them.
The front drummer carries two drums at odd angles, one floating at his chest with a drumstick stuck through its rim.
M's lowered left hand is a small crumpled fist with a grass blade growing through it, and the coat cuff above it carries a '40'-like mark.
faults.where: lower left, her left hand and cuff

faults.what: The hand holding the glowing medallion is a huge fingerless mass: one thumb at the top, then a smooth beige slab with creases, and no fingers can be counted.
faults.where: the whole hand around the medallion

faults.what: M's raised hand is a two-pronged mitten (a thumb and one finger) with the medallion pressed flat into the palm, and the medallion face shows a letter-like '&' or '$' mark and hangs on a gold chain, not a cord.
The hand holding the phone is two skin tones split by a jagged seam across the knuckles, as if the fingers were pasted on from another hand.
faults.where: his right hand with the phone, lower left

faults.what: The script says he holds the medallion, but it floats just above his closed fist, touching nothing.
The closed red umbrella hangs in the air behind her shoulder with no hand or strap holding it, and the coat edges show a ragged double cut-out outline against the background.
faults.where: upper left behind her shoulder; both coat edges

faults.what: The phone has two camera lenses at opposite top corners like a pair of eyes, and he beams up at the back of the phone, not its screen.
Indio's forearm tattoo changes from shot to shot: a zigzag band with crosses (27), blue vine scrolls (30), a row of diamonds and triangles (46).
Below the big thumb the two hands holding the note dissolve into a brown mass with creases but no countable fingers.
Indio's dark grey trouser leg has the same colour and fur-like strokes as Usman, so the dog seems to grow a giant second haunch on the left.
faults.where: left third, where the dog touches the leg
